title: engines.engine_contract_amended
description: WS-472 / FIND-122 sub-5 — fired when `cwos-frame.js confirm --amend` deliberately supersedes a still-open contract. ADR-038 Decision #6 makes the contract immutable once confirmed; the confirm gate refuses a second contract for the same (engine, target) while the prior one is open and inside the TTL, and --amend is the airtight escape valve. Emitted immediately BEFORE the replacement engine_intent_recorded, so the log reads supersede-then-record. The replacement event carries amends_contract_id pointing back here, which is what lets INV-090 tell a founder-forced amendment from a gate that leaked.

target.description: Focus/target argument of the contract being amended — matches the superseded engine_intent_recorded's target

amended_contract_id.description: contract_id of the still-open engine_intent_recorded this confirm supersedes

amend_reason.description: Founder rationale, ≥20 chars — enforced by the CLI before emission

open_age_ms.description: How long the superseded contract had been open when it was amended. Feeds the AS-472-2 falsification signal: routine sub-minute amendments mean the guard is firing on normal flow, not on real mutation.
